questions.stem: Meridian Toys, a startup firm sells 4 distinct product lines in Lakewood, and each line carries 3 different items. What is the total number of items in the product mix?
questions.explanation: The total number of items, the depth of the whole mix, is the number of product lines multiplied by the number of items in each line: 4 times 3 equals 12. Adding the two figures would mix a count of lines with a count of per-line items, and quoting either number alone captures only part of the mix.

questions.subject: MARKETING
questions.stem: Which set of assets would best support a claim that Prescott Software, a regional firm has strong brand equity in Yewton?
questions.explanation: Brand equity rests on assets such as awareness, the strength and favourability of associations, and loyalty. These create durable value and willingness to pay. A large factory or wide distribution may support a business but is not brand equity, and heavy discounting can actually weaken a brand's perceived value over time.
